root_cause: The drawer component does not manage focus when opened. After the drawer is shown via showModal() or show(), focus remains on the triggering button (or body) instead of moving into the drawer. The journey expects focus to land on the close button (or first focusable element) inside the drawer.
repair_strategy: Override the protected _showElement method in the Drawer class to focus the dismiss button (identified by data-bs-dismiss="drawer") after the native dialog is shown. This ensures keyboard users can immediately interact with the drawer content.
expected_accessibility_effect: When the drawer opens, focus will move to the close button (or first dismiss trigger), allowing keyboard users to immediately navigate the drawer controls. This satisfies WCAG 2.1.1 (Keyboard) and 2.4.3 (Focus Order).
functional_risks: If a drawer lacks a dismiss button, focus will not move (fallback to browser default).
Overriding _showElement could affect non-modal drawers; the same focus behavior is desirable.
verification_requirements: Run the journey again: pressing Enter on #filters-open should open the drawer and focus #filters-close.
Test with a drawer that has no dismiss button to ensure no errors.
Verify that Escape key still closes the drawer and returns focus to the trigger.
